author: Atheyna
body:
Map Name: BiteSizeMC
Creators: Zedther, UltraBubbles618, ScriptingCookies
Gamemode: Nebula Team Death Match.
Map Features:
- Paintings!
- Delicious hamburgers
- A computer (To play Avicus on)
- Night vision!
- A little cute kitten (awww)
- Trash can (ewww)
- Bookshelfs (Who likes to read?!)
Team Features:
-  Boys (Blue) versus Girls (Pink)
-  20 versus 20

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body: I like this map a lot! This is TDM and I think PvP is best on a flatter terrain. However, I would like to be able to PvP next to hamburgers. If i don't pvp next to a hamburger I will always lose. So maybe like ladders going up the legs of the table. Very well done map! Also, for the paintings, can you have my skin? (Nah... im jkjkjk) Regaring the name, I like it but maybe leave out the mc part so it is just Bitesize or Bitesized. Keep up the good work! *This map should still be accepted regardless if you listen to anyones suggestions xD. Its just too good. +10/10.
